summary: Client and server, on level instances (up to ~185 holders) while/after they load; created by ls::level::LevelInstanceLoadSystem (GameEngine.dll: StartLoadingLevelData, InstantiateLevel, FinishLoading, ProcessLoadCompletion), read by eoc::PlatformSystem and esv::RootLevelSystem (macOS). Holds the level-data load job and a QueryPerformanceCounter timestamp of the load start (with a 1000 = milliseconds divisor). Not saved.

fields.name: _Pad4
fields.evidence: not written by the creator; live garbage

fields.name: LoadJob
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0x93AFF0 StartLoadingLevelData: LevelData::Load(levelData, templateDescs, comp+8) fills a ref-counted pointer at comp+8 (object 0x58 bytes, refcount at +0x50, released when the load fails). Creator zeroes it; live always 0 (load finished)

fields.name: StartTime
fields.evidence: creator bg3.exe+0x3C1E9A0: QueryPerformanceCounter((LARGE_INTEGER*)(comp+0x10)). Live: 48 distinct counter values

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: creator writes 0; live always 0 (probably the stop/elapsed counter of the same timer)

fields.name: field_20
fields.evidence: creator writes byte +0x20 = 0; live byte 0 always 00

fields.name: TimeUnitDivisor
fields.evidence: creator writes *(uint64*)+0x30 = 1000; live always 0x3E8. Looks like a millisecond timer (QPC start at +0x10, divisor 1000)

open_questions: +0x10..+0x38 is probably one timer struct of the engine (start counter, accumulated value, running flag, ?, unit 1000); members +0x18/+0x20/+0x28 not established
raw_check: 96 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
